QR code generator guide

With Sorola's QR code generator you quickly create codes for websites, Wi-Fi networks, emails, or phone numbers.

1. Select QR code type

Select from the dropdown what type of data you want to encode:

  • Website (URL): Directs the scanner straight to the website you want.
  • Wi-Fi network: The scanner connects to the wireless network automatically without typing the password.
  • Plain text / SMS / Email: Create ready-made message templates or share text notes.

2. Enter details and choose color

Fill in the required fields for the type you selected. You can also change the QR code color from the default black using the color picker.

Finally, press the Update QR code button to see the preview.

3. Download finished code

When the code is ready, press Download as image (PNG). You can use the image in leaflets, on websites, or in printed materials.
